stories.title: Chainalysis says hackers stole credentials and tokens for all of its customers
stories.summary: Company said a "multifront cyberattack" included AI agents and an on-path data snatch.

stories.title: Partnering with Hacktron to find vulnerabilities in OpenAI’s systems
stories.summary: OpenAI is partnering with Hacktron to find vulnerabilities, test connections with third-party services, and strengthen defenses with frontier AI.

stories.title: Measuring how AI agents handle everyday wet-lab science
stories.summary: OpenAI introduces BioBasicsBench, a 100-task benchmark measuring how well AI agents interpret raw experimental data and handle everyday wet-lab science.
